# v68 Disclosure-Registry Verification Labels

## Scope

- Implements the first executable join after `v67_registry_firm_product_master_20260612`.
- Adds event-level `verification_timing`: `verified_at_event`, `later_verified`, `never_verified`, or `unmatched_ambiguous`.
- Uses firm-level registry linkage as the first-pass administrative verification tag.
- Separately flags exact product-text hits; firm-level matches without product-text hits remain in the review queue.
- Applies the 180-day right-censor rule for unmatched events near the sample end.

## Outputs

- `results/v68_disclosure_registry_verification_20260612/event_registry_verification_labels.csv`
- `results/v68_disclosure_registry_verification_20260612/event_registry_verification_counts.csv`
- `results/v68_disclosure_registry_verification_20260612/peer_car_by_verification_timing.csv`
- `results/v68_disclosure_registry_verification_20260612/focal_car_by_verification_timing.csv`
- `results/v68_disclosure_registry_verification_20260612/peer_minus_focal_by_verification_timing.csv`
- `results/v68_disclosure_registry_verification_20260612/event_registry_product_review_queue.csv`
